queries.query: LLM network configuration generation "large language model" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate primary studies where LLMs are applied to generate router/switch/firewall configurations or intent-to-config pipelines.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" "network" natural language to network configuration
queries.rationale: Find work on translating operator intent (natural language) into concrete device configurations or policies.
Identify generate–validate–repair pipelines, automated repair, and LLM-assisted correction of faulty configs.

queries.query: network configuration verification "NetKAT" "Header space analysis" "formal verification"
queries.rationale: Collect formal and deterministic verification tools and theory for network configs to serve as validators or gold standards.

queries.query: network change validation Mininet emulation "network change" validation simulation
queries.rationale: Find simulation/emulation-based evaluation methods (Mininet, ns-3) used to validate config changes and operational plans.
Survey literature that frames LLMs within AIOps/NetOps to understand state-of-practice, gaps, and evaluation norms.
Search for documented failure modes where LLMs produce incorrect or unsafe network commands/configs (hallucinations, fabrications).

queries.query: tool-augmented LLMs ReAct Toolformer chain-of-thought "tool use" verifier "self-correction"
queries.rationale: Locate architectures (ReAct, Toolformer, external verifiers) that combine LLMs with tools for iterative correction and grounded responses.

queries.query: constrained decoding "controlled generation" "safety" "constrained generation" LLM network
queries.rationale: Identify methods for constraining generation (templates, DSLs, grammar-based decoding) to enforce syntactic/semantic constraints for configs.
Collect existing benchmark suites and evaluate their relevance and limitations for NetOps operational validity.

queries.query: benchmark validity limitations "LLM benchmark" "extrinsic validity" "task validity"
queries.rationale: Find literature critiquing benchmark design, external validity, and metric alignment to operational goals.

queries.query: adversarial prompts network operations "prompt injection" "malicious config"
queries.rationale: Search for adversarial/attack literature showing how prompts or inputs can induce unsafe or malicious network actions from LLMs/agents.

queries.query: evaluation metrics correctness network configuration "semantic correctness" "functional correctness"
queries.rationale: Identify metrics and validators used to measure correctness of generated configs (reachability, policy compliance, connectivity tests).
Locate studies of assisted workflows where humans verify or approve LLM-proposed changes, and metrics for operator trust and workload.

queries.query: case study LLM network outage diagnosis troubleshooting "LLM" "troubleshooting"
queries.rationale: Find applied case studies where LLMs aided diagnostics or incident response to assess practical failure modes and benefits.

queries.query: open datasets network configurations "public" "router configuration" dataset "Cisco"
queries.rationale: Discover public datasets of real or synthetic network configurations/topologies useful for evaluation and reproducibility.
Gather techniques that improve interpretability/traceability of LLM outputs so operators can audit generated changes.

queries.query: agentic AI network operations "autonomous agents" "NetOps agent" safety "orchestration"
queries.rationale: Identify literature on agentic systems applied to network operations, orchestration frameworks, and safety/guardrail designs.

queries.query: synthesizing network topologies "traffic synthesis" "config synthesis" testing LLM-generated configs
queries.rationale: Search methods for generating testbeds, synthetic topologies and traffic workloads to stress-test generated configs and policies.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference/journal papers; arXiv preprints with verifiable primary artifacts (code/dataset) or accepted versions; benchmark/dataset/tool repositories with stable identifiers; IETF/RFCs and formal verification tool papers; public industry case studies only if primary data and methods are disclosed; works that explicitly target network configurations, NetOps workflows, or AIOps evaluation.
exclusion_criteria: Unverified blog posts, opinion pieces or press releases without primary data or citations; proprietary/unavailable internal reports or NDA-bound materials; non-English works unless an English translation or abstract is available; papers solely testing general NLP tasks without explicit NetOps or configuration focus; benchmarks that merely quiz factual recall without operational validators.
date_rationale: Cover the most relevant literature from ~2015–2026 with emphasis on 2019–2026 (LLM and AIOps surge). Include earlier seminal works on network verification and formal methods (e.g., NetKAT, HSA) regardless of date. Prioritize the latest 2021–2026 studies for LLM-specific methods, benchmarks, and agentic workflows, while retaining older foundational verification and simulation work for validator grounding.
